mintAuthority.summary: sUSD1+ is a Lorenzo strategy-vault receipt whose base USD1 authority is inherited from the reviewed parent, while the canonical BSC wrapper's local share issuance and mint logic are controlled by Lorenzo's CeDeFiManager. Its terminal BOSS_ROLE holder is a 2-of-3 Safe that also holds the manager's ADMIN_ROLE and OPERATOR_ROLE, so it can immediately authorize local minters/signers or replace the UUPS logic. This Mint Authority profile covers the native BSC issuance path only; Lorenzo's unresolved Interport route is recorded separately in Bridge Risk and is not counted here.

controls.label: sUSD1+ BSC wrapper share-mint path
controls.capDescription: Users can receive shares against USD1 deposits, but the manager can separately configure KYT signers and direct minter bits; the wrapper never mints base USD1.

sources.label: sUSD1+ BSC proxy and verified implementation

controls.evidence: At BSC block 112282205, the proxy resolves to verified UUPS implementation 0xaafe784a51f119d38e57717fd8a00f844bd86f13. The implementation's onlyManager modifier requires msg.sender == cedefiManager; its setRole() writes the direct MINTER/BURNER/DEPOSIT bitmask and setSigner() writes the KYT signer set. underlying() remains BSC USD1 0x8d0d000ee44948fc98c9b98a4fa4921476f08b0d, confirming the inherited parent relationship.

controls.label: sUSD1+ CeDeFiManager BOSS_ROLE Safe
controls.capDescription: The Safe holds the terminal BOSS_ROLE, MANAGER_ROLE, and CREATE_VAULT_ROLE on CeDeFiManager. It can upgrade the manager itself, or execute the currently allowlisted wrapper upgradeToAndCall(), setRole(), and setSigner() calls. setRole() can assign a direct local minter, whose mint(address,uint256) has no amount cap.
bypassSurfaces: The same Safe's CREATE_VAULT_ROLE can execute allowlisted wrapper upgradeToAndCall(), setRole(), and setSigner() calls through CeDeFiManager.
controls.evidence: Verified sUSD1+ source makes cedefiManager(), not usd1PlusVault(), the only _authorizeUpgrade gate: _authorizeUpgrade(address) is onlyManager, and cedefiManager() resolves to 0x507ec48ef26919a205a9f3b8aaf69532e20c0987. That manager's verified source gives BOSS_ROLE self-administration and sole manager-upgrade power; BOSS_ROLE administers MANAGER_ROLE, which administers CREATE_VAULT_ROLE. BscScan's complete 42-transaction manager history and receipt logs show the former 0x89583e7e7ded6659bbf05c3ce179cc88f5a59a42 role holder was revoked and 0x60707dfd714c3ac2f086d284145cd8cc6915262f granted all three custom roles. At block 112282205, hasRole confirms the Safe holds BOSS_ROLE, MANAGER_ROLE, and CREATE_VAULT_ROLE while the former holder and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE do not. getVault(0) returns this sUSD1+ proxy and allowedVaultsFuncs returns true for upgradeToAndCall, setRole, and setSigner. The Safe is v1.4.1, 2-of-3 EOA owners, with empty modules and zero guard/module-guard; no timelock was found.

sources.label: sUSD1+ CeDeFiManager BSC proxy and role history

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-26 at BSC block 112282205. The verified current sUSD1+ UUPS implementation resolves the prior ambiguity: its _authorizeUpgrade uses onlyManager, and onlyManager is exactly cedefiManager() = 0x507ec48ef26919a205a9f3b8aaf69532e20c0987. The separate usd1PlusVault() field = 0xaefc9cece593b28faead5c096856d68082254867 is declared but unused by the current implementation, so it is not attributed to the current wrapper upgrade path. CeDeFiManager's verified source defines BOSS_ROLE as the sole manager-upgrade role, BOSS_ROLE as its own admin, MANAGER_ROLE as the CREATE_VAULT_ROLE admin, and executeCommand as the operator route into allowlisted registered vault calls. BscScan's full manager transaction history contains 42 transactions; replaying every RoleGranted/RoleRevoked receipt and confirming hasRole at the observation block leaves one terminal holder of BOSS_ROLE, MANAGER_ROLE, and CREATE_VAULT_ROLE: Safe 0x60707dfd714c3ac2f086d284145cd8cc6915262f. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE has no grant in that complete history and no current holder. The Safe is 2-of-3 EOA-controlled, v1.4.1, with no enabled modules, guard, or module guard and no timelock. It can immediately upgrade CeDeFiManager, or through its current operator role execute sUSD1+'s allowlisted upgradeToAndCall, setRole, and setSigner functions; direct minter and signer membership is therefore not needed to identify the terminal controlling authority. The wrapper's complete RoleSetted/signers history is not attributed because public keyless BSC RPC log access remains range-limited, but no unknown operational key is presented as a terminal controller. Base USD1 issuance remains inherited from usd1-world-liberty-financial; no independent reconciliation or named prudential supervisor is established for the local strategy wrapper. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the 2-of-3 Safe can authorize uncapped local minting immediately, while no whole-supply reconciliation or prudential supervisor is evidenced. Re-research 2026-08-15 covered Lorenzo's mainnet OTF publication, OTF guide, current product page, and public audit-report index: they describe sUSD1+ as fund shares with NAV based on vault assets, liabilities, and total shares, but the strategy combines RWA, CeFi, and DeFi positions with off-chain execution; no dated recurring report or live reserve feed reconciling total sUSD1+ liabilities to those strategy assets was found, and USD1 parent attestations do not reconcile the local wrapper, so reconciliation remains unknown. Mint/bridge boundary: these controls and the UUPS path cover native BSC wrapper issuance only. Lorenzo's official sUSD1+ bridge selection redirects to an Interport route, but no Ethereum token or bridge authority was verified; that evidence gap is recorded under bridgeRouteRisk and is not attributed to Mint Authority.
